messages:
samuel: Hey team — our trial credits disappeared overnight. We only had a small scheduled index job hitting /embeddings but account shows ~120k tokens used. No one on my side kicked off anything big. Can you check?
elaine: Hi @samuel — sorry about that. Can you paste the project id & a sample request id (x-request-id) if you have one? Also did you apply a promo code to this org recently? :thinking_face: 
samuel: project: acme-retail-prod, promo code I tried was SPRINGTRIAL2026 but the UI said 'applied' and balance stayed the same. I pulled logs from our host: shows repeated 502s and then retries. Example stack:```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...
Body: {"input": "..."}
```
No idempotency header in our older SDK.
mike: Putting on eng radar. If the client retries on 502 without idempotency, that can double/triple embed calls. Also embeddings are per-input billing. Do you have the scheduled job config? Might be batching setup too small so many calls.
ingest-worker-bot: scheduled job (index-upsert) runs every 5m, parallelism=4, batch_size=8, retry_policy=retry_on_5xx, max_attempts=5. Backoff=linear(5s). Logs show bursts at 02:10-02:20 UTC with 502 spikes.
elaine: That sounds like a retry storm. Billing team — can you pull the token usage for acme-retail-prod around 02:00-03:00 UTC and check for repeated request-ids? @billing-bot any automated refunds for trial accounts?
billing-bot: Balance snapshot for acme-retail-prod: prior_balance=100000 credits, post= -18500 credits (consumed). No auto-grants. Refund policy: manual provisional refunds available upon investigation.
mike: Quick repro suggestion for the customer: change retry_policy to exponential backoff and include an Idempotency-Key header per batch, or switch to a single upsert batch with larger batch_size. That should prevent duplicate embeddings on transient 5xx.
samuel: Thanks — I can patch the job tomorrow. For now can we get provisional credits refunded? The trial promo didn't take and this burnt our free tier.
elaine: Yep, we can do a provisional refund while eng confirms root cause. Billing, please apply +18,500 credits provisional and mark the promo SPRINGTRIAL2026 to be reverified.
billing-bot: Provisional refund of 18500 credits applied. New balance: 100000 credits. Promo SPRINGTRIAL2026 flagged for manual review.
mike: Also will open an internal ticket to update SDK docs: recommend Idempotency-Key for upserts + show a snippet:```python
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}", "Idempotency-Key": batch_uuid}
# retry with exponential backoff
```
elaine: Can you add the request id or a few example request headers from your logs @samuel? That helps us match server traces. If you DM them I can escalate. :lock: 
samuel: Sent DM with 3 x-request-ids and timestamps. Appreciate the quick action.
elaine: Thanks. I'll follow up once eng confirms the retry correlation. For now refund stands and promo flagged. Closing here after verification. :thumbsup:
